aria: Animated recap of the Nuggets' 120 to 107 win at Utah: Jamal Murray's step-back 3-pointer with 3:25 left that made it 108 to 104, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Murray's 36 points, the top scorers, how the Nuggets won, and the next game.

notes: Box score from Hoops Nightly's game page for the Nuggets' 120–107 win at Utah on Nov 27, 2026, the last NBA Cup group game for both teams; Digest Sports matches the key lines. All 120 Denver points and all 107 Utah points add up from the player lines, as do the shooting totals (43 of 91, 10 of 24 from three, 24 of 26 FT for Denver; 40 of 83, 14 of 44, 13 of 17 for Utah) and assists (32–29). The quarter scores (27–25–33–35 to 22–31–32–22) are on Hoops Nightly, Digest Sports and FOX Sports; Utah led 53–52 at the half, and it was tied 85–85 after three (Fastbreak Journal; the line score). Points off turnovers (29–10) and points in the paint (58–48) are from Hoops Nightly only; bench points (25–49) add up from the box. The biggest leads (Denver 14, Utah 6) are on Hoops Nightly; Field Level Media has Denver's 14 at 24–10 and a 6-point Utah lead in the third. Utah's turnover total differs between sources (18 or 19), so it isn't used. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Jamal Murray scored 36, 12 of them in the last six minutes (Field Level Media), and Nikola Jokić had 17 points, 9 rebounds and 15 assists. Denver trailed 102–97 with 5:53 left and closed on a 23–5 run (FOX Sports; the play-by-play). Denver finished NBA Cup group play 3–1 but missed the knockout round behind group winner Dallas; Utah finished 0–4 (Field Level Media). Jusuf Nurkić made his season debut for Utah with 11 assists (Field Level Media; KTVX). Next: Denver visits Toronto and Utah hosts Phoenix, both on Sunday (Fastbreak Journal; Hoops Nightly).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Jamal Murray's step-back 3-pointer with 3:25 left that made it 108–104: Hoops Nightly's and Digest Sports' play-by-play both have a 25-foot step-back three from Nikola Jokić at 3:25, after Aaron Gordon's layup made it 105–104; KTVX says Denver went up 108–104 "with 3:25 left, on a step-back 3-pointer by Jamal Murray." So the board's Nuggets +1 to +4 is 105–104 to 108–104. Svi Mykhailiuk's three made it 108–107, and Denver scored the last 12 points. The defender isn't described, so the step-back is drawn with the template's plain pull-up from about 25 feet. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Denver Nuggets or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Murray's listed 6-foot-4 and 215 pounds with No. 27 (Basketball-Reference; RealGM), in Denver's road kit. Neither page lists a wingspan, so his arms are at the default length. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn in the kit with the default skin tone. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
